mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, sku_id AS skuId, total, available, reserved, version, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM inventories WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE inventories SET available = available - #{quantity}, reserved = reserved + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND available >= #{quantity}
UPDATE inventories SET total = total - #{quantity}, reserved = reserved - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND reserved >= #{quantity}

UPDATE inventories SET available = available + #{quantity}, reserved = reserved - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND reserved >= #{quantity}
